summary: This replication stage executed a thorough audit and a rigorous partial replication of Paper P. The agent downloaded the public MUSE fastText embeddings and reproduced multiple key benchmarks, including original word translation (79.2/89.0), LinearSVC classifier accuracies, cos(SVC, PCA) = 0.389, ES Original MWEAT (3.6918), ES Shift/Hybrid differences (0.3090), and the Spearman correlation (0.4498). Critically, it discovered and demonstrated that the paper's MWEAT permutation p-values are mathematically degenerate artifacts of statistic saturation at |Σ assoc|, and showed that orthogonal alignment preserves within-language cosines so De-Align cannot differ from Original. It accurately diagnosed why missing unreleased private matrices prevent exact replication of the mitigated bilingual rows, maintaining exemplary calibration across all findings.
